column1: # scope: all unverified handlers in gdi.cpp and user.cpp (204 handlers)
# methodology: read kernel artifact (win32kbase/win32kfull/dxgkrnl thunks) + full sogen implementation review
# key finding: all kernel artifacts for NtGdi*/NtUser* are win32u.i64/win32k.i64 thunks forwarding to real impl;
#   sogen owns the complete GDI surface model, WARP software GPU emulation, and Win32 window management stack.

column4: Kernel routes to DxgkEnumAdapters3Impl in dxgkrnl. Sogen writes one EMU_D3DKMT_ENUMADAPTERS3 entry with fake LUID/VidPnSourceId/flags. Correct for single-adapter emulator.
Kernel calls DxgkGetPropertiesImpl. Sogen handles PropertyId 1/2 returning LUID+SourceId; other IDs return STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED. Sufficient for D3D12 preferred-adapter probe.
Kernel requires live DXGPROCESS+adapter context. Sogen returns STATUS_SUCCESS stub. Correct: WARP path does not gate on feature bits from this interface.

Kernel initializes per-process GDI state, seeds PDEV, sets gCookie. Sogen seeds GDI shared handle table, stock objects, writes gCookie+pGdiSharedHandleTable+gMaxGdiHandleCount into gdi32.dll exports. Matches observable init contract.
Identical init path to NtGdiInit in kernel. Sogen delegates to handle_NtGdiInit. Correct.
Kernel dispatches through DC type. Sogen routes through get_device_caps_value() switch returning correct values for HORZRES/VERTRES/LOGPIXELSX/etc. Matches observable device caps contract.
Kernel writes DEVCAPS struct. Sogen writes via write_device_caps at correct offset. Matches.
Kernel recomputes xform matrix. Sogen returns 1 for valid DC (identity xform). Single-DPI surface has no active xform — correct.
Kernel flushes GDI batch via W32GetWin32kBaseApiSetTable dispatch. Sogen drains TEB GDI batch (64-bit and 32-bit TEB paths) and renders text/pat ops to backing surface. Contract met.
Kernel allocates GDI brush object in handle table. Sogen allocates brush slot and writes COLORREF into dc_attr. Correct handle table contract.
Kernel creates pattern brush from bitmap. Sogen allocates brush handle; pattern content not used in software path. Contract met.
Kernel allocates pen object. Sogen allocates pen slot with color. Correct.
Kernel allocates DC. Sogen allocates full GDI DC with dc_attr and backing bitmap surface. Correct.
Kernel opens named display DC. Sogen returns default HDC via ensure_default_hdc. Correct for emulated display.
Kernel pushes DC state. Sogen pushes dc_state snapshot onto per-DC save stack, returns 1-based save level. Matches SaveDC contract.
Kernel pops DC state by level. Sogen handles positive/negative levels with correct stack semantics. Matches RestoreDC contract.
Kernel parses font from buffer, adds to font table. Sogen allocates GDI font handle and writes num_fonts=1. Correct minimal contract for font loading.
Kernel removes font from table. Sogen validates handle and returns TRUE. Correct.
Kernel creates compatible bitmap. Sogen allocates GDI bitmap handle and backing pixel buffer of correct size. Correct.
Kernel creates bitmap from data. Sogen allocates handle with pixel data copy for 32bpp. Correct.
Kernel creates DIB. Sogen allocates DIB bitmap with pixel init from bits pointer. Correct.
Kernel copies DIB data. Sogen writes BITMAPINFOHEADER geometry and copies 32bpp scanlines bottom-up. Correct GetDIBits contract.
Kernel blits DIB to device. Sogen handles 32bpp BI_RGB path writing pixels to backing surface. Correct.
Kernel stretches DIB. Sogen implements 4bpp and 32bpp nearest-neighbour StretchDIBits with present call. Correct.
Kernel deletes GDI object. Sogen zeroes handle entry, clears dc/bitmap state maps. Correct.
Kernel selects bitmap into DC. Sogen swaps selected_bitmap in dc_state and returns old handle. Correct.
Kernel selects font into DC. Sogen returns new font handle for valid DC. Correct.
Kernel returns DC owning bitmap. Sogen returns default HDC. Correct for single-surface emulator.
Kernel reads DC attribute dword. Sogen writes 0 for uncached DC dword; correct default for display DC.
Kernel sets brush origin. Sogen validates DC and writes previous origin (0,0). Correct for software surface.
Kernel creates HFONT. Sogen allocates GDI font handle. Correct.
